name: mark_point
description: Measure a visible scene point in world metres from an observation-bound pixel. Use when: a precise surface measurement is needed instead of a guessed 3D coordinate; reuse the same point_id only for a complementary view of the same physical point. Effect: read-only world access; persists a local pending or solved measurement record and feedback overlays. Returns: success, point_id, pending/solved/verified status, world xyz_m when solved, source views and action_workspace diagnostics; pending results name next_views. Does not: establish semantic identity, contact, reachability or a grasp; old moving-camera pixels are not current geometry after motion. On error: select a valid interior pixel at the returned view size or use a complementary view; refresh stale evidence after an action.

point_id.description: Nonempty local identifier for this physical point; reuse across complementary views of the same point, never across different points.

view.description: The exact view name whose returned pixel is being measured; actual camera or derived view, not a camera chosen from an old observation.

x.description: Horizontal integer pixel at the returned view size, OpenCV top-left origin; dynamic image bounds apply.

y.description: Vertical integer pixel at the returned view size, OpenCV top-left origin; dynamic image bounds apply.
